metadata.description: Content governance for AI coding assistants: the terms, voice and rules a project goes by, discovered from its own material and enforced on every edit.

plugins.name: kapi
plugins.description: Discover a project's content context from what it already has, refresh it as a reviewable change-set, and check every edit against it — in any format, and in every language you publish. One kapi skill driving the local CLI; bowrain is one option for cloud governance.
